description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 ("yes. cheap try."); shape chosen 2026-11-18 ("use the new, faster exception machinery and cut out the atom").

lib/json.fz: integer_digits accumulates acc*10 + sign*d as a plain integer; 64-bit overflow raises ArithmeticError, rescued once per number, and the cold path (wide_digits) re-scans the digits to report {:sequence, start, token} or continue into a fraction/exponent. integer_step and the integer | :overflow union are deleted; the float path carries :zero_exponent | :exponent_only instead of the accumulator.

Converting from text (String.to_integer) was tried first and refuted: it raises ArgumentError, and the token slice plus Integer.parse tuple raised 01507 (20/42 -> 22/50) and the distiller drive count (26 -> 27).

Signal: scalar boxes per decoded integer 0 on all paths (fixture 01710); bench numbers decode 21.6 -> 14.2 Mcycles, docs 27.5 -> 25.3; all distiller pins fall.
